# truenas_service (Data Source)

Fetches the current state of a TrueNAS service by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service name: nfs, cifs, ssh, ftp, iscsitarget, snmp, ups, nvmet, webshare.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the service starts automatically on boot.
- `id` (String) Service name (used as Terraform ID).
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the service is currently running.
